title: Series II Select graphite, angled wall bracket on the house wall over the outdoor dining table (Studio City courtyard)
kind: CAD composite on a real photo (wall mount)
source: w-tungsten-electric-studio-city-4 (real photo, 2560 px original); heater is the Series II CAD. Old Series I heater removed from the plate (image model, removal only, checked for drift); camera solved from the wall's vanishing lines and a known length; heater rendered in Blender (Cycles) in that camera; contact occlusion, sky/sun-direction shadow, grain and grade matched. Low resolution: plate below 4K, not upscaled.
